(1) A real last word is never deleted on missing evidence: the stumble cleaner now measures the audio around the last word every time (the level of the word and of the whole dictation), and a word followed by measured silence is kept as the word it is — the b2962 rule that dropped "locally" from "Git commit locally" read a missing measurement as "undetermined" and deleted a real word; that path is closed. (2) A real last word is never deleted on a weak doubt either: the cutoff test that dropped "now" from "fix it now" (heard at confidence 0.53, silence after it) now yields a whole real word only to a STRONG conviction — the decoder's confidence under 0.3, the same bar that catches phantom words at 6 of 6 with 0 of 320 false alarms; the plain bar keeps governing half-spoken fragments.
